تتعايي (form VI)
# تَتَعَايَيْ (tataʕāyay) /ta.ta.ʕaː.jaj/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
# تُتَعَايَيْ (tutaʕāyay) /tu.ta.ʕaː.jaj/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
